apps.name: Adaptive Theme
apps.description: Automatically switches Android's system-wide light and dark theme based on the device's ambient light sensor instead of a fixed schedule. It offers customizable lux thresholds, battery-friendly event-driven sensing, Material You design, and several one-time setup methods without requiring root.

apps.name: Arcticons
apps.description: A monotone line-based icon pack for android with over 8300 icons, one of the largest free & open source icon-packs available. Featuring consistent and elegant handcrafted icons, giving you a minimalistic clutter-free experience on your phone. Available in three flavours: Dark, Light and Material You.

apps.name: Prism
apps.description: A beautiful open-source wallpapers app for Android. It is built with Dart on top of Google's Flutter Framework. Prism relies on its Community and WallHaven and Pexels APIs as its source of beautiful and large collection of Wallpapers.
